feeds.title: Polly Jemima
feeds.description: This blog is authored by Polly, a single mama, writer, homeschooler and nature lover. Sharing her thoughts about homeschooling, Lifestyle, food, family and more.

feeds.title: Let them be small » Home Education
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, mum of three children. We are a home-educating family. Here I share about our Home Ed journey, days out, books and activities and well as my quest to stay sane by running and hitting the gym!

feeds.title: Monkey And Mouse » Home Education
feeds.description: I'm Jenny. I started Monkey and Mouse in 2015 as a way to share our daily adventures and kids play ideas with others. We've been home-educating for over 5 years now, the children have never attended school. So we have lots of ideas of things to do with the kids! Every month I write a home education diary to keep track of the kids progress and to show what home education looks like for new home educators.

feeds.title: Our Muslim Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: Assalamu alaikum and welcome to Our Muslim Homeschool! We offer support and resources that make homeschooling our Muslim children rewarding and beneficial. Follow this blog for homeschooling resources, product and curriculum reviews, advice about home-education and day-in-the-life videos.

feeds.title: Rahmah Muslim Homeschool
feeds.description: Rahmah Muslim Homeschool is dedicated to Muslim parents who homeschool or are considering to homeschool their children. Its mission is to educate children according to the Qur'an and the Sunnah.

feeds.title: Sometimes It's Peaceful
feeds.description: Gill Kilner is an autonomous home educator in the UK writes about her life with children of various ages.

feeds.title: Home Education Shop Blog
feeds.description: Focuses on providing information and digital resources to home educators.

feeds.title: Oxford Home Schooling Blog
feeds.description: Oxford Home Schooling is one of the UK's leading providers of home education to children who have withdrawn from school for a variety of reasons. Keep up to date with the Oxford Home Schooling Blog for tips, news and resources for homeschooling.

feeds.title: Adventure Travel Family Blog
feeds.description: Explore UK home education & family travel blog. Articles about homeschooling, unschooling, our family gap year & travel with kids tips! My name is Hannah and I'm a home education parent and coach. I've been home-educating for 11 years and I provide information about home education, unschooling & gentle parenting.

feeds.title: Wolsey Hall Oxford
feeds.description: Wolsey Hall Oxford is one of the world's most experienced online homeschooling providers with Primary, Secondary, IGCSE and A level. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on curriculum, resources, tips and more!

feeds.title: An Adventurous Education
feeds.description: We're the Douses, homeschooling, adventuring family of four from Kent, UK. Through this blog, we hope to provide inspiration about how to ignite a lifelong love of learning and adventure through educational activities and voyages of discovery at home and around the world.

feeds.title: My Little Poppies Blog
feeds.description: Hi, all! I'm Cait. I'm a school psychologist, mom to three amazing children, and an unexpected homeschooler. One can find our family's favorite resources, tips, and tricks on My Little Poppies Blog.

feeds.title: LoveLearningOnline Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blogs about working from home and homeschooling during COVID-19, home schooling resources, activities, tips and more! LoveLearningOnline was created to provide affordable online tuition and exam coaching. We are a company that believes the future of learning is online. The teachers and I are passionate about bringing education into the 21st century by creating engaging, online lessons.
